scope: Prespecified extension within the previously used FRED-MD archive; not an external-dataset or foundation-model benchmark.
freeze_rule: Commit this protocol and its runner before examining these series' benchmark results. Do not replace series, candidates, seeds or settings based on outcomes.

panel.selection_rule: Minimum one-step validation MAE among four AR configurations; exact ties retain supplied order. All configurations use the same rolling window. Test labels never choose the configuration.
panel.comparison_scope: One fixed baseline and the three listed competitors, separately for each series. No simultaneous claim across series. Bootstrap assumptions must be assessed separately from descriptive forecasting scores.

reference.scope: OLS only: dense and sparse AR, unpenalized intercept, same training windows and recursively forecast next observation. Not a ridge equivalence or optimized-baseline claim.
reference.timing_scope: Model fit plus one-step prediction on preconstructed identical histories; warm-up excluded, alternating method order. Median wall time on this machine, not a general speed guarantee.

simulation.process: Stationary Gaussian AR(1), E[Y]=-delta, Var[Y]=1; initialize from its stationary law. Baseline squared loss minus candidate squared loss equals -Y, so E[d]=delta.
simulation.null: H0: E[d] <= 0; delta=0 is the boundary null, delta=0.15 the fixed alternative. Both methods use a fixed terminal sample and this same unconditional mean-loss target.
simulation.reference: Infeasible known-phi Gaussian oracle with exact finite-sample variance [n+2*sum((n-k)*phi**k,k=1..n-1)]/n**2. No estimated nuisance parameters; not a deployable method.
simulation.seeds: Path SeedSequence([seed,1,phi_index,replication]); bootstrap SeedSequence([seed,2,phi_index,replication]). Reuse the same centered path and bootstrap seed for both delta values.
simulation.uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals for individual rejection probabilities; paired bootstrap-minus-oracle rejection-rate difference with sqrt(sample_variance(paired_difference,ddof=1)/R). Raw paired decisions retained.
